ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ is 22, $PB$ and $PC$ bisect $\angle ABC$ and $\angle ACB$ respectively, $PD \perp BC$ at D, and $PD = 3$, what is the area of $\triangle ABC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the diagram, connect AP, and through point P, draw PE$\perp$AB at point E, and PF$\perp$AC at point F,\\
$\because$ PB and PC bisect $\angle ABC$ and $\angle ACB$ respectively,\\
$PD\perp BC$ at D,\\
$\therefore$ PD=PE, PD=PF,\\
$\therefore$ PD=PE=PF=3,\\
$\because$ the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$ is 22,\\
$\therefore$ the area of $\triangle ABC$ is\\
$\frac{1}{2}AB\times PE+\frac{1}{2}BC\times PD+\frac{1}{2}AC\times PF=\frac{1}{2}\times PD\times (AB+BC+AC)=\frac{1}{2}\times 3\times 22=\boxed{33}$.

method.method_draft: Use the inradius formula. First read the diagram as a triangle ABC with B and C on the base, A at the top, an interior point P connected to B and C, and a perpendicular segment PD dropped from P to side BC. From the text, PB and PC bisect angles B and C, the perimeter of triangle ABC is 22, and PD=3. Since P lies on the internal angle bisectors of two angles of triangle ABC, P is the incenter. Therefore its perpendicular distance to any side is the inradius, so r=PD=3. The area of a triangle equals inradius times semiperimeter: K = r·s = 3·(22/2)=33.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是三角形 ABC，A 在上方，B、C 在底边两端；点 P 位于三角形内部，P 分别连到 B、C；从 P 向底边 BC 作垂线，垂足为 D，即 PD 垂直 BC。推理：题目给出 PB 和 PC 分别平分 ∠ABC 和 ∠ACB，因此 P 在三角形 ABC 的两个内角平分线上，所以 P 是三角形 ABC 的内心。内心到三边的距离相等，即该距离为内切圆半径 r。又 PD 垂直 BC 且 PD = 3，所以 r = 3。三角形周长为 22，半周长 s = 22/2 = 11。由面积公式 K = r·s，得 K = 3 × 11 = 33。
